content:
Daily priorities (scratchpad) â€” Liam Patel â€” 2026-03-16

Top 3 for the week (focus):
- 1) Finalize Dedicated capacity SLA language with legal + sales â€” need agreement on data retention and incident windows. Meeting Thurs 10am. (Prep: markups on draft SLA, see Confluence INF-Q2-roadmap)
- 2) Decision on Private deployment onboarding flow (self-serve vs SRE-assisted). Need cost/ops tradeoffs from infra by EOD Wed.
- 3) Approve rollout plan for Optimize beta to 5 pilot customers; coordinate CS + solutions eng for canaries.

Today â€” musts:
- 09:00 â€” Leadership sync (30m) â€” quick read: agenda items updated in Slack. Bring up Dedicated SLA risks.
- 11:00 â€” Legal review (60m) on SLA edits (Maya + Caroline) â€” confirm data isolation language.
- 14:00 â€” Product review: Private onboarding flows (Ravi, Harini, Anna) â€” bring cost model slide.
- 16:00 â€” Sync with CS on Optimize pilot readiness (Sofia) â€” check evaluation criteria and rollback plan.

Follow-ups / action items:
- [ ] Confirm final SLA incident window numbers from SRE (ticket: JIRA-INF-4123) â€” assigned to Harini, due Thu.
- [ ] Get infra cost estimates for self-serve private deployments (quantify 90/95 pctl) â€” assigned to DevInfra.
- [ ] Review GH PR #987 for console rollout flags (quick pass) â€” leave comments by EOD.
- [ ] Send invite for pilot kickoff (dates options: 3/23 or 3/30) â€” ask CS which cohort prefers earlier date.

Notes / talking points (for meetings):
- SLA: prefer clear, testable SLOs (p99 latency, % availability) + well-scoped fallbacks (model variant routing). Want measurable penalties only for enterprise Dedicated contracts.
- Private onboarding: tradeoffs: self-serve reduces SWEs needed but increases support risk and longer time-to-live for customers. Suggest 2-tier: self-serve for small customers + SRE-assisted for regulated customers.
- Optimize beta: define clear success metrics â€” token savings %, latency regressions <= 5%, customer satisfaction score. Canary plan should include automatic rollback triggers.

People to ping (quick):
- Maya (Legal) â€” ask about any problematic clauses in SLA draft.
- Harini (SRE) â€” incident window feasibility + monitoring hooks.
- Ravi (Product) â€” finalize onboarding options slide deck.
- Sofia (CS) â€” confirm pilot customer list + readiness.

Open questions / things to surface:
- Do we have capacity to take 2 additional Dedicated contracts next month without affecting hosted capacity? (platform/infra numbers needed)
- If we default to self-serve private onboarding, what additional guardrails (quota, default model pins) are required?
- Any customer legal asks that would require engineering changes to the control plane?

Quick personal TODOs (inbox items):
- Clear 10 unread emails flagged by Maya re: SLA edits.
- Approve expense report from Solutions Eng (attached in Confluence).
- Block 2 hours tomorrow for deep work on Q2 roadmap slides.

Backlog / later this week:
- Prep for board update: short slide on inference economics and Dedicated pipeline. Draft due by next Tue.
- Consider small pilot for on-prem packaging with customer X â€” ask Solutions Eng for initial estimate.

Random notes (scratch):
- Customer feedback: latency complaints mostly around long-context sessions; consider KV cache improvements and clearer guidance for batching.
- Reminder: pull recent cost-per-token report from Finance before product review.

End of scratchpad.

-- L
